title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator meeting agent for GCC
summary: Hold: the stated 24-hour maximum for app availability changes omits Microsoft's warning that client changes can rarely take six days. The roadmap facts, licensing and control routes are supported; the labelling advice also needs the documented warning that labelled notes become inaccessible in Teams.
